svg.text: Ballard sets (B) and Bozo sets (Z): seed and both-sides accounts
our captured Instagram timelines, 101 fixed files, 24,907 posts · 37 nodes · 40 co-post edges · 89 credit edges · 2026-10-28
Colour (and width) band = number of posts the link was seen on; no numbers on the lines. Each band lists the lowest count in it.
co-post = both accounts owner/collaborator on one post. credit = one account owner/collaborator, the other in credits; arrow points at the credited account.
Nodes = the three Ballard seeds, mariofriasoficial, all 14 bolsonaro-name accounts, and every both-sides account (tiers in both_sides.tsv). Evidence: graph_edges.tsv.
